/direct/extra-fields/http-proxy-no-passw: A proxyPassword field in a direct connect request no longer becomes the saved proxy's password: the proxy comes from the saved settings only (a bug fix; the renderer never sends one).
/direct/extra-fields/*/config: A concurrency field in a direct connect request no longer fixes the size of the transfer pool: the field is gone and the pool is demand-sized, capped by the site's connection limit. With the http proxy, the proxy also has no password, as saved.
/stores/legacy-array-shapes/connect/extr: A concurrency key in a stored site no longer fixes the size of the transfer pool, for the same reason. No version of FTPeach wrote one.
/direct/refused-concurrency/*/refused: A direct connect request's concurrency is no longer read, so a value above 128 is not refused and the connect goes ahead.
/direct/refused-no-host/*/refused/messag: A direct connect is checked by the same code as a saved site's: the refusal keeps its code (invalidInput, which is what the renderer shows by) and says what was wrong in details.
/direct/unknown-protocol/*/unreadable: A request naming an unknown protocol is still unreadable; the reader that saved sites use says so in its own words.
/direct/webdav-url-alias/*/config: A direct connect no longer accepts url as another name for webdavUrl: the renderer never sent it, and a saved site never read it. The connect is refused for want of a WebDAV address.
